analysis.visual_description: On the plot. The plot pegged by the tiring-house door at nine. The title board is turned to the wood. Two hired men are in the room, and the night's chain is off the gate.
On the plot. Your own strip in your hand has cues and no play named at the head. The turned board stays turned.
On the plot. The gate chain coiled on its staple, not locked. The two men are still in the room.
